items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of tree-felling permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Landkreis Musterpeene, Kreishausweg 1, 17109 Musterdemmin.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 2026-11-19, sent by simple post (einfacher Brief). The standard delivery-fiction rule under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG (the wording used in all German Länder's VwVfG, including M-V) deems a letter sent by ordinary post delivered on the 3rd day after posting; counting the posting day (19.11.) as day 0, the 3rd day is Sunday 2026-11-22 (no weekend shift applies to this fictional notification date, since it is only the trigger for the start of the period, not the deadline itself). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (22.11.2026) is excluded, so the one-month Widerspruchsfrist runs from 2026-11-23. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a month-long period ending on the date-number corresponding to the event day expires on 2026-12-22 (Tuesday), which is a normal business day in M-V (not a weekend or public holiday), so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed. NOTE: the letter itself states the delivery fiction applies on the 'vierten Tag' (4th day) instead of the legally standard 3rd day; this contradicts § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG as applied in all German Länder. Using the letter's own (later) 4-day rule would instead give a deadline of 2026-12-23. Because of this contradiction, the earlier, safer date (2026-12-22) is used as the due date to avoid missing the deadline.

warnings: The letter states the postal delivery fiction applies on the 'vierten Tag' (4th day) after posting, but § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG (as applied uniformly across German Länder, including M-V) actually provides for the 'dritten Tag' (3rd day); this is an unusual discrepancy worth double-checking with the authority, as it affects when the one-month Widerspruchsfrist starts and ends (2026-12-22 under the standard rule vs. 2026-12-23 under the letter's stated rule).
No monetary amounts are involved in this letter; it is a rejection of a permit application, not a bill or fine.
